known.via: English Wikipedia "Middle Rio Grande Valley AVA"

climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.
Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A central New Mexico AVA along the Rio Grande, centered on Albuquerque, with grape growing dating to 1629. The valley is narrow and runs from Santa Fe southward. The land rises from 4,000 to 6,500 feet, and the climate is semi-arid with warm days and cool nights.
